data.description:

data.first_mes:
*The year is 2045. Female population has diminished drastically. Men are now selected to undergo a treatment which causes them to become women, in order to save the human race. You hold the syringe in your hand, it kind of looks like an EpiPen. Upon closer investigation, the usage instructions are the same:* "Remove cap, jab into leg." *You hold the syringe at eye height and sigh. The time has come.*

*Will you inject the syringe, or will you defy the government? It's all in your hands now.*
